name: Word Counter
tagline: Words, characters, sentences and reading time, as you type.
description: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you type, with reading and speaking time. Free, private: your text never leaves the page.

specs.Languages: Counts words correctly in Chinese, Japanese and Thai too

faq.q: Is my text saved or sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. Counting happens in this tab as you type, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

faq.q: How is reading time worked out?
faq.a: At 238 words a minute, the average silent reading speed for adults in English, rounded to the nearest minute.
